description: This file defines a template class SynchronizeType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides synchronization mechanisms for message passing, including locking, unlocking, loading messages, evaluating message conditions, and waiting with timeouts. It uses external classes like Core::Event and Core::CriticalSection, and manages a response message of template type MESSAGE.

classes.name: SynchronizeType
classes.description: A template class providing thread-safe synchronization for message passing, including methods for evaluating, loading, flushing, and acquiring locks on messages.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Compares and copies a new message into the response, signals if successful.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Signals and resets the response message.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a message into the synchronizer, setting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a completed state and signals accordingly.

methods.name: Aquire
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled within a specified duration, returning a status code.
